'''Tyrus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who held the post of [[City/Legends|City]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] at [[Sobrik]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] that was under the control of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Battle for Sobrik|attack]] on Sobrik during the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|ongoing conflict]] on Balmorra.
